content.text: It's hard to tell from the brief bug description, but if the problem can be successfully worked around by uploading the CSV with a content type of "application/csv" instead of "text/csv", then this is the same bug as the above.
That work-around functioning would make sense because Jena (RDF engine used in fedora) thinks that 'text/csv' is a valid RDF type, where as 'application/csv' isn't a valid mime-type to begin with.
Providing the mime type was 'text/csv' then the behavior of it working in 4.7.1 seems strange to me because it was not really working on the master branch.
@awoods - I'm assuming we won't touch the 4.5 branch.   I think we can close / resolve this once this
is accepted and merged onto 4.7 as well.
, IIRC, there was a Jena upgrade in the 4.7.0-4.7.2 timeframe that made some big changes, which might be responsible for this change.
: I am inclined to close this issue as resolved in 4.7.1... since it is probably fair to say that this bug does not justify a patch release to the 4.5.x branch.
it sounds good to me. Please feel free to close it. Thank you for looking into it.

comments.body:
Possibly a duplicate of FCREPO-2508 Closed ?

 

It's hard to tell from the brief bug description, but if the problem can be successfully worked around by uploading the CSV with a content type of "application/csv" instead of "text/csv", then this is the same bug as the above.
That work-around functioning would make sense because Jena (RDF engine used in fedora) thinks that 'text/csv' is a valid RDF type, where as 'application/csv' isn't a valid mime-type to begin with.

Providing the mime type was 'text/csv' then the behavior of it working in 4.7.1 seems strange to me because it was not really working on the master branch. 

@awoods - I'm assuming we won't touch the 4.5 branch.   I think we can close / resolve this once this PR is accepted and merged onto 4.7 as well.
Bethany Seeger, IIRC, there was a Jena upgrade in the 4.7.0-4.7.2 timeframe that made some big changes, which might be responsible for this change.

Yinlin Chen: I am inclined to close this issue as resolved in 4.7.1... since it is probably fair to say that this bug does not justify a patch release to the 4.5.x branch.

Thoughts?
Andrew Woods it sounds good to me. Please feel free to close it. Thank you for looking into it.
